title: Voter citizenship and ID rules (SAVE Act)
summary: Proposals to require documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections and photo ID to vote, including the SAVE Act (S. 128) and the SAVE America Act. Supporters say the rules protect election integrity; opponents say they would make it harder for eligible citizens to register and vote. The Senate debated the SAVE America Act in March 2026 but has not held a final up-or-down vote on it; related votes are listed below.

promises.name: Darline Graham
promises.quote: As your Senator, I will fight tirelessly to PASS the SAVE America Act, and support eliminating the filibuster to do so.
promises.promise: Said she will fight to pass the SAVE America Act and support ending the filibuster to do so.

promises.name: Darline Graham
promises.quote: If the filibuster is the only thing standing in the way of passing the SAVE America Act, then I'm a YES vote to end it.
promises.promise: Said she will vote yes to end the filibuster if that is required to pass the SAVE America Act.

promises.name: Jon Husted
promises.quote:
I’ve never missed a vote.
 
I’ve voted for the SAVE America Act six times.
 
Any day we take a vote on SAVE is a day I will be in DC to vote yes.
promises.promise: Said any day SAVE is voted on he will be in DC to vote yes.

promises.name: James E. Risch
promises.quote: I am an original cosponsor of the SAVE Act and proud to safeguard every Idahoan’s vote. We must keep American elections in American hands. I will continue to push for a vote on this important bill with @SenRickScott.
promises.promise: Said he will continue pressing for a Senate vote on the SAVE Act.

promises.name: Bill Cassidy
promises.quote: Only American citizens should vote in American elections. This is basic common sense. I will proudly cosponsor the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register and protects the integrity of our elections.
promises.promise: Said he will cosponsor the SAVE Act requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.

promises.name: John W. Hickenlooper
promises.quote: We should be making it easier for Americans to vote, not harder. If the SAVE Act ever comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the SAVE Act if it reaches the Senate floor.

promises.name: Gary C. Peters
promises.quote: If the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. I oppose any efforts that jeopardize Americans’ fundamental right to vote.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no if the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor.

promises.name: Ben Ray Luján
promises.quote:
“The right to vote is precious, almost sacred. It is the most powerful nonviolent tool or instrument in a democratic society. We must use it.”

My good friend John Lewis was right. I will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a vote in the Senate.
promises.promise: Said he will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a Senate vote.

promises.name: Mark R. Warner
promises.quote: If the SAVE Act comes up in the Senate, I will vote no.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no if the SAVE Act comes up in the Senate.

statements.name: Jon Husted
statements.quote: I urge my colleagues to vote yes on this bill to establish nationwide photo ID standards and give Americans better-run and honest and fair elections.

statements.name: Darline Graham
statements.quote:
The American people are demanding immediate action from Congress on election integrity. That’s why the SAVE America Act is the first bill I am cosponsoring in the Senate. 

These reforms are common sense and need to be enacted quickly.

statements.name: Lisa Murkowski
statements.quote: I support voter ID and believe that only U.S. citizens should vote in our elections. But the SAVE America Act goes beyond that and provides no time for proper implementation. It would ultimately disenfranchise some Americans in rural communities, so I oppose it.

statements.name: Richard J. Durbin
statements.quote:
The SAVE America Act would make it harder for millions of Americans, including married women, seniors, and veterans to vote.

That is an affront to our democracy, and I will be voting no.

statements.name: Cindy Hyde-Smith
statements.quote: I rise today in strong support of the SAVE America Act.

statements.name: Cindy Hyde-Smith
statements.quote: The American people are not naive. They see what’s happening, and they’ve been asking us – DEMANDING of us – to do something about it. The SAVE America Act does something about it. It requires proof of citizenship to register and vote in federal elections. That’s not radical.

statements.name: Shelley Moore Capito
statements.quote: The SAVE America Act closes this illegal voting loophole by requiring photo ID to vote, proof of citizenship to register, and requiring States to remove noncitizens from the voter rolls.

statements.name: Lisa Murkowski
statements.quote: I will restate again that the goals of what we are talking about with the SAVE America Act I support.

statements.name: Roger Marshall
statements.quote: I rise today to say I support the SAVE America Act.

statements.name: Steve Daines
statements.quote: I urge the rest of our colleagues to get on board, support the SAVE America Act, stand up for election integrity, and vote for the SAVE America Act.

statements.name: Jon Husted
statements.quote:
Ohio is a model for what our elections should look like: easy to vote and hard to cheat.
 
That’s why I support the SAVE America Act. All Americans deserve to cast their vote with confidence in our election systems.

statements.name: James E. Risch
statements.quote: I cosponsored the SAVE America Act because showing identification to vote is plain common sense. The Senate must pass this bill and send it to the President’s desk.

statements.name: Tommy Tuberville
statements.quote: It is far past time for my Republican colleagues in the Senate to stop worrying about getting reelected and pass one of the most critical pieces of legislation that we will see in our lifetimes--the SAVE America Act.

statements.name: Jon Husted
statements.quote:
I’ve always been for making it easier to vote and harder to cheat. I believe the SAVE Act is an important part of preserving the integrity of our elections. 

I’m proud to cosponsor this smart bill to make it harder to cheat at the ballot box.
